title: TBILLYIELD: 2156 of 2156 on the identical matrix the repair was fitted to
upstream_status_verbatim: The former `G6-10` TBILLYIELD row is signed off and removed.
status_plain: A 2,156-case settlement by duration by price sweep first exposed 308 one-ULP failures. Changing the expression association from ((100-pr)/pr*360)/days to ((100-pr)/pr)*(360/days) -- and changing nothing else -- took the same matrix to 2,156 of 2,156 exact with no structural or numeric mismatches. That is the whole finding, and it is a good one: a single association choice was the entire defect. It is also, by the source's own word, the IDENTICAL matrix. The corpus that exposed the failures is the corpus the repair was fitted against and then re-scored on. No fresh or held-out TBILLYIELD corpus exists anywhere in the primary sources, so this full pass carries the repair-target flag.

reader_warning: This is a full pass on the corpus the repair was fitted to and re-scored on -- the source's word is "identical". No held-out TBILLYIELD corpus exists.
